words.meaning: 预计出发时间（Estimated Time of Departure）
words.example: The minibus ETD (Estimated Time of Departure) is half past four.
words.exampleZh: 小巴的预计出发时间是四点半。

words.example: Friday's guest speaker is TBA (To Be Announced) until the bureau confirms.
words.exampleZh: 在局里确认之前，周五的嘉宾发言人仍待公布。

words.example: Which room we use for the hearing is TBD (To Be Determined).
words.exampleZh: 听证会用哪一间房，还待确定。

words.example: If there is no staff number, write N/A (Not Applicable) in that box.
words.exampleZh: 如果没有工号，请在那一栏填写不适用。

words.example: Leave the roster edit as WIP (Work in Progress) until payroll agrees.
words.exampleZh: 在薪酬处同意之前，这次排班修改先保持为进行中工作。

words.example: This vulnerability CVE in the base image is why we rebuilt the lab API today.
words.exampleZh: 基础镜像里的这个镜像漏洞编号，就是我们今天重建检验接口的原因。

words.example: The base image we used last month now has a critical flaw in its library.
words.exampleZh: 我们上个月用的基础镜像，现在它的库里有一个严重缺陷。

words.example: The distroless build dropped the shell, so we debug the lab API from the sidecar.
words.exampleZh: 精简镜像的构建去掉了 shell，我们只能从边车容器调试检验接口。

words.example: Run the results container rootless so a break-in cannot own the worker.
words.exampleZh: 让结果容器以非特权方式运行，就算被突破也拿不下工作节点。

words.example: A read-only root stopped the bad script from writing into the container filesystem.
words.exampleZh: 只读根文件系统拦住了那个坏脚本，它写不进容器的文件系统。
